description.zh: 读取和修改站点的商品、订单、博客与页面内容。适合维护小型网店或落地页。首次连接在浏览器登录 Wix 授权并选择站点。
description.en: Read and update products, orders, blog posts, and page content on a Wix site. Useful for maintaining a small shop or landing page. Sign in to Wix and choose a site on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Wix 并选择站点
authHint.en: Sign in to Wix and choose a site on first connect
